host.cpu: AMD Ryzen 9 9955HX, 32 logical CPUs, shared with other checkouts
host.server: one postgres:<major>-alpine container per run, pinned to CPUs 24-27 with a 4 GB memory limit, shared_buffers=1GB, max_wal_size=4GB, synchronous_commit=off, removed after the run
host.order: invocations 1 to 3, each running PostgreSQL 18, 17 and 15 in turn
